title: Home screen — the paper fan, colour in the icons
question: The paper screen exactly as it was; the only change is that the sectors are plain ivory and each icon carries its area's colour, like the moon of Day's end. Approve it, or steer.

options.label: Paper, coloured icons
options.thesis: Ivory cotton paper, blind-embossed fan, gold foil, and colour only in the icons.
options.viewport: Serif greeting, the fan, Today with three rows and a gold day line, write-anything bar, tab bar.
options.risk: The image still droops the last sector; the build draws seven equal sectors.

options.label: As it was (tinted sectors)
options.thesis: The previous version, for comparison: the colour in the sectors.
